Multiple Road Accidents Across India Result in Fatalities and Injuries

Several road accidents have occurred across India, resulting in multiple fatalities and injuries. In Surguja, a speeding car hit a pedestrian on NH-43, killing him instantly. In Banihal's Khari area, a car plunged into a gorge, killing one person and injuring four. Himachal Pradesh's Kinnaur district saw a car accident where one person died and three were injured. In Punjab, a collision between a cantter and a car in Sangrur killed a young businessman, while another accident in Hoshiarpur district resulted in three deaths and two injuries. A BMW hit a motorcycle in Chandigarh, causing one death, and a bus-bike collision in Nalanda killed a man returning from his sister's house, injuring two others.
